summary: There's a part of you that knows a fast, restless mind and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you think and talk your way through anything and you build things that last and carry real weight — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: There's a part of you that knows a fast, restless mind and a serious streak and a quiet fear of not being enough flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you think and talk your way through anything and you build things that last and carry real weight — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk. Thoughts may come through carefully here. There can be a natural awareness of consequence, timing, and the weight of what gets said.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you build things that last and carry real weight.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel — or you hold back, harden, or wait for a permission that never comes.
integration: Let thinking and speech and discipline and limits cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Thorough and exacting, with little patience for small talk.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you build things that last work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
